description: FILED s444 from agent G (s443g; found via the nohup gate flake).  PRE-EXISTING divergence: %SIG does not reflect an INHERITED disposition. Fix shape: at %SIG read (or image init), query the actual disposition (sigaction) and report IGNORE for SIG_IGN.
